en: *sniff* *sniff*{PAGE}Yes... That's it! The smell of juicy meat!

The target FOE is to the south, but a{SAUT}mountain of treasure's waiting for us{SAUT}if we take the roundabout path north...{PAGE}As always, we'll leave it to you, Joker!
